I got into recruiting because I was tired of watching great people get filtered out by keyword-matching, and great teams settle for "good enough." That's still the standard I hold myself to.

As Lead Technical Recruiter & Lead Campus Recruiter at FICO (2022–2026), I recruited for everything from Executive and AI/ML roles to Cloud, DevOps, and Cybersecurity — serving as strategic recruiting partner to the Chief Analytics Officer and building a 96% intern-to-full-time conversion pipeline. Before that, I built Concentra's technical recruiting function from the ground up, and spent two years as a Senior Technical Recruiter at Kforce recruiting across client accounts.

What I bring to a team: a track record of 94% offer acceptance, 92%+ year-one retention, and the ability to run 20+ concurrent high-priority searches without losing the personal touch that makes candidates actually say yes.

How I work

My approach to a search

01

Intake & scorecard

A working session with the hiring manager to define what success actually looks like — not just a job description.

02

Sourcing & outreach

Targeted, personal outreach — not a mass blast. Every candidate gets context on why they're a fit.

03

Screening & shortlist

Structured screens against the scorecard. You see a short, honest list — not a hundred resumes.

04

Interviews & offer

Coordination, feedback loops, and negotiation support so the process doesn't lose good candidates to slow logistics.

05

Check-in at 90 days

A follow-up with both sides to make sure the fit is holding — and to catch problems early if it's not.
